events.text: The fifteenth night of the Ghost Month: the Hungry Ghost Festival.

choices.text: Set out a feast for the dead

effects.log: Your table is full for the hungry spirits.

choices.text: Help at the temple's great offering

effects.log: Mountains of rice for the forgotten.

events.text: Lanterns float down the river to guide lost spirits home.

choices.text: Float one for someone you lost

effects.log: It drifts away, glowing.

choices.text: Float one for the nameless dead

effects.log: For those nobody remembers.

events.text: Monks chant all night to release suffering spirits.

effects.log: The chanting fills you with peace.
Tea, candles, and a long night.

events.text: Opera is performed for the ghosts. The front rows are empty.

effects.log: The actors play as if the front row is full.
The actors are grateful.

events.text: At the end of the festival, people rush to grab offerings from a high platform for luck.

ok.log: You grab the lucky cake. Cheers!

fail.log: Knocked off the pole into the crowd.

effects.log: Every child goes home with a cake.

events.text: A thief steals the offerings meant for the dead.

ok.log: A starving boy. You feed him properly.

fail.log: He escapes, arms full of fruit.

effects.log: The dead would not mind feeding the living.

events.text: You dream an ancestor visits you on the festival night.

effects.log: They tell you to be kinder to yourself.
They only smile.

events.text: A spirit medium claims to channel a dead master and challenges you.

ok.log: The medium fights well, possessed or not.

fail.log: Whatever it is, it hits hard.

choices.text: Ask the dead master a question

effects.log: The answer is strange, and useful.

events.text: You float your first river lantern.

effects.log: It floats away with your wish.
The river looks like the sky.

events.text: A graveyard with no names on any stone.

effects.log: A long evening. The nameless are remembered.
The dead are good company.

events.text: Walking home after the festival, you hear footsteps behind you. Nobody is there.

effects.log: The old rule. You reach home safely.
The footsteps stop. Politeness works on everyone.

events.text: The Ghost Month ends. The gates of the underworld close for another year.

effects.log: Farewell, wandering ones.
It feels good.
